Embedding Scatter

Source: R/figure-plots-embedding.R
PlotEmbedding.Rd

Draws cells on two embedding coordinates (for example UMAP) as small points without frame, coloured by a key (cell type, cluster, neighbourhood). Points are drawn in layers in the order of the data rows, as given by EmbeddingLayers(), and rasterised at the style resolution so that vector output stays small. Point sizes follow figure scatter areas (squared points); individual keys can be drawn as diamonds with an outline. Optional cluster labels with a white halo, arrow axes or plain axis titles, and texts filled from plot data complete the panel.

Usage

PlotEmbedding(
  data,
  x = "x",
  y = "y",
  key = "key",
  limits = NULL,
  subset = NULL,
  colours = NULL,
  default_colour = "#BBBBBB",
  sizes = 0.3,
  shapes = NULL,
  edge_colours = NULL,
  edge_widths = NULL,
  labels = NULL,
  label_size = 4.2,
  label_colour = "ink",
  halo = 0.6,
  axis_style = c("none", "arrows", "titles"),
  axis_titles = c("UMAP 1", "UMAP 2"),
  arrow_fraction = 0.16,
  arrow_text_size = 4,
  title_size = 4.6,
  title_pad = 1.5,
  raster = TRUE,
  legend = NULL,
  texts = NULL,
  values = NULL,
  style = ManuscriptStyle()
)

Arguments

data

Point data with coordinate and key columns.

x, y, key

Column names.

limits

Display limits c(xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax) or a one-row data frame with these columns (see EmbeddingLimits()).

subset

Optional named list: keep rows whose columns take these values (for example one clinical group per panel).

colours

Colours per key: named vector or list, or a data frame of key and colour.

default_colour

Colour of keys without a colour.

sizes

Scatter areas in squared points, one value or per key.

shapes

Optional marker per key: "o" (circle) or "D" (diamond).

edge_colours, edge_widths

Optional outline colour and width (points) per key.

labels

Optional data frame of text labels (label, x, y), for example from ClusterLabelPositions(), drawn bold with a white halo.

label_size, label_colour, halo

Label size, colour and halo width.

axis_style

"none", "arrows" (two arrows in the lower left corner) or "titles" (axis titles beside the panel).

axis_titles

Titles of the two axes.

arrow_fraction

Arrow length as a fraction of the x range.

arrow_text_size, title_size, title_pad

Text sizes and the distance of axis titles from the panel (points).

raster

Rasterise the points (default) or draw vectors.

legend

Optional legend: list of keys, labels, at (upper left corner in panel fractions), ncol, size, marker_size (points), label_spacing, column_spacing, handle_text_pad, handle_length (in font sizes), title, title_size, title_align, and optional colours and shapes overriding those of the points. Columns are filled first.

texts, values

Free texts and template values, as in PlotAnnotatedHeatmap(); templates are filled from values restricted to subset, or from the subset data.

style

A ManuscriptStyle() object.

Value

A 'ggplot2' object.

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(500), y = rnorm(500), key = sample(c("a", "b"), 500, TRUE))
PlotEmbedding(d, limits = c(-4, 4, -4, 4), colours = c(a = "#e34948", b = "#2a78d6"),
              axis_style = "arrows", axis_titles = c("Dim 1", "Dim 2"))
